name: EWeb
welcome: Welcome to **EWeb**, a web browser for the Atari Falcon and the TT. It fetches pages itself, secure ones too, and shows them in its own fonts: text, links, headings, lists and tables, in every screen mode from monochrome to true colour.

window.title: The window
window.intro: One window, as a browser has it:
items: Back and Forward, Reload (Stop while a page loads) and Home.
The address: type one, or words to search for, and press Return.
The info line: a link's address under the mouse, or what a load is doing.
The page: click a link to follow it, right-click for more.

diagram.title: How EWeb reaches web sites
after: EWeb talks to sites itself: for secure ones (https) the Falcon's 68030 and DSP do the encryption, checked against the root certificates next to EWEB.PRG. See [[Secure sites]].
